name: CodeForces
intro: Codeforces 是公开竞赛编程平台与题源，不是具有固定题数、划分和评分协议的单一 benchmark。模型报告必须自行声明比赛时间窗、题目子集、提示、尝试预算、在线或离线判题路径及聚合方式；只有协议一致的结果才可直接比较。
build_method: 报告自行选择Codeforces比赛与题目, 固定提示和尝试预算, 声明在线或离线评测器
metric: 报告相关：Accuracy, Pass@k, Rank, Rating
eval_feature: 官方题面与元数据, 可选官方提交判题, 协议披露边界
scale: 无固定规模；由各模型报告定义
build_method_en: Report-defined Codeforces contest and problem selection, frozen prompt and attempt budget, declared online or offline judge
eval_feature_en: Official statements and metadata, optional official-platform judging, explicit protocol boundary
intro_en: Codeforces is a public competitive-programming platform and problem source, not one benchmark with a fixed item count, split, or scoring protocol. Model reports must define their contest window, problem subset, prompt, attempt budget, online or offline judging route, and aggregation; only runs with the same protocol are directly comparable.
scale_en: No fixed scale; defined by each model report

drawio_review_note: Evidence-bounded to the official Codeforces API object and method documentation (https://codeforces.com/apiHelp/objects and https://codeforces.com/apiHelp/methods) and the official rating-system article https://codeforces.com/blog/entry/20762, reviewed 2026-07-18. Codeforces has no standalone paper and no fixed dataset: it is a continuously operated competitive-programming platform and problem source. Official Problem, Contest, Submission, RanklistRow, and RatingChange objects expose contest and problem metadata, difficulty ratings, tags, standings, verdict, testset, passedTestCount, time and memory consumption, points, penalties, and rating changes. A model report must therefore freeze its contest window, problem subset, contamination and eligibility rules, prompt, language, attempt and sampling budget, tools, and time budget. Official online submissions use Codeforces hidden tests, special or interactive judges, platform limits, and verdicts. A report-owned offline test corpus and sandbox is a different, non-canonical route that must be fully specified. Accuracy/Pass@k for a fixed set and points/penalty/rank/rating for a contest are alternative report-defined aggregations, not universal interchangeable Codeforces metrics; comparisons are valid only under the same frozen selection, protocol, judge, and aggregation.
